TREATMENT

Pigmentation

Even-toned, smooth, confidence-boosting personality safely & effectively.

Overview

Reviva’s signature Anti-pigmentation programme combines medical-grade peels, Q-switched laser toning, glutathione boosters and prescription topicals, Laser toning, biorepeel, COSMELAN peel, Chemical peels by Dr. Aarushi Tyagi.

Key benefits

  • Visibly brighter, even-toned skin
  • Targets pigmentation at the root
  • Safe for sensitive intimate areas
  • Smooth, soft, hydrated finish
  • No downtime — back to routine the same day

Who should opt

  • Post-pregnancy pigmentation
  • Pre-bridal & special occasion preparation
  • Anyone seeking even-toned body skin

The Procedure

01

02

Customised peel or Q-switched laser session

03

Glutathione / vitamin C boosters as needed

04
